author: Praxis V
title: MR–SelfTune Graph PCA v2 (spec-compliant distances): k=50, kd=22, δ=0.10, nPC=100 (seed=0)
abstract: Fixes distances to true Euclidean values while retaining self-tuned weighting and soft reciprocal boost. Pipeline: log-normalize counts, batch-aware HVGs, 100-PC SVD, kNN with kd-scaling (kd=22, δ=0.10), weighted connectivities (row-normalized), and union symmetrization. Returns both connectivities and distances.
